# Estifanos Engineering

> Estifanos Engineering develops and maintains open-source software and SDKs for Convex applications.

## Documentation

- [Convex Auth](https://estifanos.sh/convex-auth/llms.txt): Authentication and authorization for Convex applications using @estifanos-sh/convex-auth.
- [Convex Embedded](https://estifanos.sh/convex-embedded/llms.txt): Local-first storage and replication for Convex applications using @estifanos-sh/convex-embedded.

## Pages

- [Estifanos Engineering](https://estifanos.sh/): Landing page for the engineering company.
- [Estifanos LLC](https://estifanos.com/): Landing page for the parent company.
